title: lcm

messages.description: number(s) to find the LCM of, outputs the result
lcm of two or more floats

body: [lcm] returns the least common multiple of two or more numbers. Floats are truncated to integers. Negative values are accepted, "0" is treated as "1". It has two inlets for setting two floats, but a list input to the left sets 2 or more floats to get their lcm.
